name: PlayerSprites
description: Replace your gamemodes with animated sprites!

ghost-trail-behavior.name: Ghost Trail Behavior
ghost-trail-behavior.description:
Defines how to handle GD's Ghost Trail when enabled, names are pretty self explanatory. 

- Untouched: Ghost Trail remains the same, will show the Vanilla GD icon sprites. 

- Replace: Will make the Ghost Trail show your currently active Sprite pack's sprite. 

- Disable: Disables Ghost Trail altogether.

export-folder.name: Export Folder
export-folder.description: Defines where exported sprite packs get saved as .zip files.

taunt-keybind.name: Taunt Key
taunt-keybind.description: Defines the key to use for the **'Taunt'** function. Plays one of your active Sprite Pack's taunt animations, if there's any for your current gamemode.

enable-button.name: Enable Taunt Button
enable-button.description: Enables a button to Taunt with by pressing it, instead of using the Keybind. Mainly intended for Mobile users, obviously.

button-pos.name: Manual Button Position
button-pos.description:
Controls where the Manual Trigger Button appears on screen. 
- Bottom Left: Bottom Left Corner 
- Bottom Right: Bottom Right Corner 
- Top Left: Top Left Corner 
Top Right is not available due to very easily conflicting with the Pause button, sorry.

button-scale.name: Button Scale
button-scale.description: Controls the Scale of the Taunt button, if enabled.
